mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, candidate_id, knowledge_entity_id, name, narrative_role, chat_enabled, reviewed FROM character WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND chat_enabled=TRUE
SELECT alias FROM character_alias WHERE character_id=#{characterId} ORDER BY alias
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO character_profile (character_id, story_point, role_description, appearance, personality, values_text, goals, speech_style, major_experiences, attitudes_toward_others, known_facts, system_prompt) VALUES (#{characterId}, #{storyPoint}, #{roleDescription}, #{appearance}, #{personality}, #{values}, #{goals}, #{speechStyle}, #{majorExperiences}, #{attitudesTowardOthers}, #{knownFacts}, #{systemPrompt})

INSERT INTO profile_evidence (character_profile_id, profile_field, paragraph_id, image_id, source_type, inference_type, description, confidence) VALUES (#{characterProfileId}, #{profileField}, #{paragraphId}, #{imageId}, #{sourceType}, #{inferenceType}, #{description}, #{confidence})
mapper.select: SELECT cp.id, cp.character_id, cp.story_point, cp.role_description, cp.appearance, cp.personality, cp.values_text AS values, cp.goals, cp.speech_style, cp.major_experiences, cp.attitudes_toward_others, cp.known_facts, cp.system_prompt FROM character_profile cp JOIN character c ON c.id=cp.character_id WHERE c.book_id=#{bookId} AND c.chat_enabled=TRUE

SELECT id, character_profile_id, profile_field, paragraph_id, image_id, source_type, inference_type, description, confidence FROM profile_evidence WHERE character_profile_id=#{profileId} ORDER BY profile_field, id
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status='PROFILE_GENERATED', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{bookId}
